description: Gives people access to a site (owner): role editor or viewer invites collaborators by email (on a workspace site editor makes a Workspace Member, a seat each, maybe after the Workspace Owner approves; viewer: that site only, no seat), visitor lets emails or company domains (acme.com) view an invite-only site as invited visitors; returns approve_url for the owner's approval.

confirm_token.description: From the first call: re-call with it (site only) for the approval status

emails.description: Email addresses; for visitor also company domains, e.g. acme.com (required unless confirm_token)

notify.description: visitor: email each new address (default true)

role.description: Required unless confirm_token. An audience (students, clients) is visitor (an invited visitor): sees only the invite-only site. viewer is a collaborator: also sees versions and people

name: add_people
title: Add people
